#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, subprocess, sys, time
# ~8 MiB input: 4 MiB of request text plus a large directory/accounts section.
identities = ["sip:user%d@host%d.test" % (i, i % 300) for i in range(2048)]
directory = {ident: ["sip:%s@alias.test" % ("a" * 200), "tel:+1202555%05d" % i]
             for i, ident in enumerate(identities)}
accounts = {"s%d" % i: {"primary": identities[i], "allow": [identities[(i + 1) % 2048]] * 3}
            for i in range(2048)}
gateways = {"gw": {"local_domains": ["host%d.test" % i for i in range(300)],
                   "peers": {"p": ["host%d.test" % i for i in range(300)]}}}
body = "z" * 1500
raw = ("MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: <SIP:user1@HOST1.TEST.>;tag=q7\r\n"
       "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\nCall-ID: sample-73\r\nCSeq: 0009 MESSAGE\r\n"
       "Content-Type: text/plain\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\n\r\n%s" % (len(body), body))
jobs = [{"gateway": "gw", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "s1"}, "trusted_out": True,
         "raw": raw} for _ in range(2000)]
data = json.dumps({"directory": directory, "accounts": accounts, "gateways": gateways,
                   "jobs": jobs}).encode()
print("input bytes", len(data))
t = time.time()
proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"], input=data, capture_output=True)
print("exit", proc.returncode, "time %.2f" % (time.time() - t), "stdout", len(proc.stdout),
      "stderr", proc.stderr[-300:])
r = json.loads(proc.stdout)["results"]
print(len(r), r[0]["status"], r[0]["identity"])
PYEOF
